ar.notesInstructions: Write clear Modern Standard Arabic, not dialect. Translate explanations, section titles and diagram labels into Arabic. Keep code, mathematical expressions, units and proper names unchanged. At first use, give the Arabic technical term followed by its source-language term in parentheses when useful. Never translate source IDs or JSON keys. Preserve uncertainty rather than guessing a translation.
